title: `ClientNotifications.js` crashes on mount: deps array references `fetchNotifications` before its `const` declaration (TDZ); also uses MUI (wrong library), hardcoded mock data, local-only state mutations
description:
**File:** `vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/notifications/ClientNotifications.js`
**Lines:** 108–116, 128, 3–31
**Root Cause (Crash):** `useEffect(..., [fetchNotifications])` at line 116 evaluates the deps array when `useEffect` is called. `fetchNotifications` is declared with `const` at line 128 — it is in the temporal dead zone at that point. Modern JS engines (V8 without `const→var` transpilation) throw `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'fetchNotifications' before initialization` on every mount.
**Root Cause (Dead Component):** Even if hook ordering were fixed, `fetchNotifications` sets 4 hardcoded mock items and never calls the real API. All components are imported from `@mui/material` — the project uses Chakra UI everywhere. `markAsRead`, `markAllAsRead`, `deleteNotification` only mutate local state and never call the backend.
**Impact:** Critical — the entire ClientNotifications page is inoperable. It crashes before rendering, users see a React error boundary, and no real notifications are ever displayed.
**Fix:** Rewrite component to use `useNotifications()` context hook (real API, real socket data) and Chakra UI components. Move `fetchNotifications` declaration above `useEffect` to resolve the hook ordering issue.
fixEvidence: Full rewrite using `useNotifications()` context hook + Chakra UI; TDZ eliminated (no local `fetchNotifications`); real API data via context
